kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/examples/complete/main.tf --
module "this" {
  source  = "../.."
  rules   = { a = {} }
  targets = { a = [{ input_path = "$.detail" }] }
}
-- base/main.tf --
locals {
  targets = flatten([
    for index, rule in var.rules : [
      for target in var.targets[index] : merge(target, { rule = index, Name = "${replace(index, "_", "-")}-rule" })
    ]
  ])
}

resource "aws_cloudwatch_event_target" "this" {
  for_each   = { for v in local.targets : v.rule => v }
  rule       = each.value.rule
  arn        = "arn"
  input_path = lookup(each.value, "input_path", null)
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

variable "rules" {
  type = any
}

variable "targets" {
  type = any
}
